notes.units: 1 bETH = 1 ETH = 1e6 units (6 decimals); one unit = 1e12 wei on Ethereum
notes.limits: supplyCap 280 ETH = the vault cap; bucket 28 ETH refilled in 24 h (324 units a second, the integer below 28e6 / 86400) = the vault windowLimit; minBurn 7 ETH = the vault l2MinBurn
notes.l2Build: L2 deposit-only launch build: release bloch-l2-2026-11-03-next-native-78d4921c, bloch-l2-evm build commit `926d2cf` against native 78d4921c (follower cdf5da5c, produce-dev e3f1a290, settled-rpc 53e88565; SHA256SUMS 6d3bd628, the owner's signing target); network.genesisHash = the pinned L2 genesis 632e45ae
notes.vault: deploy the Ethereum vault first (beth-vault.config.json, tools/deploy-pontes/vault_pontes.py); its verify output fills ethereum.vault/route/vaultCodeHash/vaultCap/vaultGuard
notes.held: HELD: deploy_pontes.py refuses this config without --rehearsal while the route's launch records say held (tools/signatario-stable/native_ether.py)
notes.TBD-owner: source.revision; deployer.address (fresh hardware-wallet key, nonce 0, never 0x703a...); deployer.fundedBy.safe (Bloch Inc Safe address); signers.set[0..6].operator and .address (7 fresh L2 mint keys from the key ceremony); guardians.set[0..2].operator and .address (3 fresh L2 token guardian keys); ethereum.vault, ethereum.route, ethereum.vaultCodeHash, ethereum.vaultCap (from vault_pontes.py verify); ethereum.vaultGuard.guardians (the 3 Ethereum vault guardian addresses, sorted ascending); tx.maxGasPriceWei (L2 fee market)
notes.launchDesign: the frozen BridgedStablecoinV3 (creation keccak 0xe560441f...1de7) over NativeEtherSourceVault mode 1: mint chain, guardian cancel, 6-of-7 unpause, T = 0 with the 12 h delay, MAX_PENDING 2,048. Honest mints are at least minDeposit (7.004 ETH) and the bucket admits 28 + 14 ETH per 12 h delay, so at most 6 honest mints queue
notes.keys: the same seven signer and three guardian keys as every route (docs/BRIDGE-V3-KEY-CEREMONY.md); every digest binds its chain, vault and token
